title: Run tournaments with a scoreboard
lead: `arena tourney bots/ --rounds R`: round-robin over many seeds, run in parallel, with a reproducible scoreboard.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** a persistent hill (later tier).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goal 5 and acceptance criterion C18. Tournament stats across seeds are the named mitigation for ISA balance.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body:
- Tournament module and tests.
- The `arena tourney` subcommand.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- The pairing list for N bots is complete with no duplicates.
- Seeds derive deterministically from the round number.
- The scoreboard is identical regardless of thread count and match completion order.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
- Parallel matches with standard-library threads; results gathered and ordered deterministically.
- Per-bot stats across seeds for the balance check.
- Gap: PROJECT.md does not define the scoring rule (points for win, tie, loss). Propose one to the owner.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `arena tourney bots/ --rounds 100` finishes, and two runs give identical output (`diff` is empty).

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: Branch `slice/<id>-tourney` in `.worktrees/<id>`. One commit when the owner asks.
